scope: OpenCode Go 全量复核（docs 页价表 + /go 落地页限额表）。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 月额度 $60→$80；Space Bunny 转计费行、Claude Haiku 5.5 新增；三个限时免费无限量模型记录不建点；Go Plus $40 全表记录，沿用 2026-10-01『另行处理』裁定不建点。其余行价格与月额度逐项核对未变。

officialLimitWording.round5QuoteGone: round5（2026-09-06）页面明示共享额度『5 hour limit — $12 of usage; Weekly limit — $30 of usage; Monthly limit — $60 of usage』；本轮（2026-10-14）该引文已从 docs 页消失。
officialLimitWording.currentQuote: Usage limits are defined as monthly dollar amounts. … Each model has the following usage limits: 5-hour — 20% of the monthly limit; weekly — 50%; and monthly — 100%. Each model's monthly limit below determines how its usage counts toward those allowances.
officialLimitWording.interpretation: 『the monthly limit』指价表内该模型自己的 Monthly limit，不再有独立共享池。交叉验证：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 月额度 $80，官方月估算 173,330 请求 = 旧 $60 档 130,000 的 4/3，且 5h 估算 34,670 ≈ 173,330×20% —— 估算按 $80 全额推导；若共享 $60 仍在，月估算应维持 130,000。据此取消 min(共享$60,·) 截断；除 DeepSeek（$80>60）外其余模型 Usage ≤$60，数值不受影响。
officialLimitWording.peakHours: DeepSeek 系高峰不变：01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday; all other hours, including weekends, are Off-Peak.
officialLimitWording.formula: 模型月Usage / (0.97*cacheRead + 0.025*input + 0.005*output) / 100 亿（标准负载，与 round7 一致）
